summary.intent: Execute phase 19.2 (IPFS upload performance optimization) gap closure — fix two verification failures: missing PERF-09 requirement registration and non-definitive post-optimization baselines.
summary.outcome: Gap closure plans were created and partially executed. PERF-09 registration (plan 03) and three-point local baseline collection (plan 04) were spawned in parallel, with plan 04 having a checkpoint for user to run load tests. The session ended mid-execution.

repo: Phase 19.2 optimizes IPFS upload performance via two layers: SDK-level concurrent pin orchestration (Promise.allSettled for IPNS publish + folder metadata update) and Kubo-level pebbleds datastore replacing flatfs.

Load test harness is at tests/load/src/ with scenarios in tests/load/src/scenarios/upload-throughput.test.ts — collects p50/p95/p99/min/max/avg latencies plus throughput ops/s, runs N clients × 20 files each (1KB–500KB).
REQUIREMENTS.md tracks PERF-01 through PERF-08; PERF-09 was referenced in plans but never formally registered — a traceability gap.
Docker Compose for IPFS infrastructure is at docker/docker-compose.yml; deployed to host 192.168.133.114. Switching to pebbleds requires deleting the ipfs_data volume (destructive).
Pre/post baselines are stored in .planning/baselines/ (e.g., 19.2-pre-optimization-baselines.md and 19.2-post-optimization-baselines.md).
Git commits for the three optimization stages: before optimizations = parent of 4087fa2b6, SDK-only = 565dccd5d, SDK+Kubo = HEAD.

code.finding: Upload throughput load test scenario — runs N clients × 20 files each with file sizes 1KB–500KB.
Metrics harness collects per-operation p50/p95/p99/min/max/avg latencies and throughput ops/s.
Client pool harness manages concurrent test clients for load tests.
Replanned from staging-based validation to three-point local baseline approach (no-opt → SDK-only → SDK+Kubo) to avoid destructive staging deployments and eliminate environment confounding variables.

workflow: Initial verification failure was caused by comparing baselines from different environments (staging vs localhost) with different client counts (10 vs 5) — environment consistency is critical for performance benchmarks.
Three-point local baseline strategy (before all opts, after SDK layer, after all opts) isolates each optimization's contribution more cleanly than a single before/after comparison.
The GSD --gaps-only flag filters to only plans with gap_closure: true in frontmatter, allowing targeted re-execution without re-running completed plans.
Pushing branch to remote before requesting infrastructure changes on remote host is the correct flow — host can pull updated configs directly.

friction: Post-optimization baselines were captured in a different environment (staging) than pre-optimization baselines (localhost) with different client counts, making the comparison non-definitive and requiring gap closure.
PERF-09 requirement was referenced in implementation plans but never formally added to REQUIREMENTS.md, causing a traceability gap caught only at verification.
Switching to pebbleds datastore requires deleting the IPFS data volume — destructive operation that means previously pinned content needs re-pinning.
open_items: Three-point local baseline collection (plan 19.2-04) is in progress — user needs to run load tests at each of the three git checkout points and provide results.
PERF-09 formal registration in REQUIREMENTS.md (plan 19.2-03) was spawned but completion not confirmed in transcript.
Final phase 19.2 verification has not been re-run after gap closure — needed to confirm all 6 must-haves pass.
Phase transition to 19.3 (or whatever comes next) has not occurred.
